filename_legends.note: Per module/feature — not one global dump. Glossary in plain language, then associated file paths.

rules: Default basenames are speakable: identity first, then pitch, then speed; omit default dimensions.
Optional style=safe_twin yields a machine-safe twin (kebab segments joined by --).
Never emit opaque p0/hex stems or robot key=value stems (pitch-plus-8st / speed-0pct).
Content hash may append as a short suffix AFTER human labels, never instead of them.
asset-manifest stores the human path; hash stays a separate asset field.
When new generated assets are claimed (helper >= 0.5.5), a per-feature filename legend MUST exist; listed paths must match speakable or safe-twin helper output.
Do not rewrite published blob history; stop emitting new hashy or robot basenames on pins >= 0.5.5.
apply_checklist: Identify the naming surface (generated artifact filename, asset-manifest path, committed media basename, or filename legend).
Choose identity; set pitch/speed only when non-default.
MUST load modules/human-output-naming/SKILL.md and call scripts/human_filename.build_basename before write (optional style=safe_twin).
Write or update the per-feature filename legend (glossary + associated paths).
Record the human path in the manifest; keep hash as a field (suffix only after human labels if needed).
Do not rewrite published blob history unless a scoped migration requires it.
acs_prompt_inject_note: After hotload verify, mention output filenames, asset-manifest paths, and per-feature filename legends (not titles only): MUST load human-output-naming (hon) before naming generated artifacts; use speakable basenames (omit defaults); keep a legend per feature.
